How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At COREMERCH, our architecture is built on a foundation of free and open-source tools, designed to provide creators with a sovereign digital commerce stack. This means that every component, from hosting to payment processing, is under your control. With NOWPayments, your USDT payment gateway is seamlessly integrated into your stack, allowing for instant and secure transactions. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script power your backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets manage your order storage. The entire process is automated, freeing you to focus on creating and selling your digital products.
